name: listDeliverablesForUser
shortDescription: Retrieves a list of all deliverables currently assigned to a specified Stump participant.
description:
Overview

Fetches a list of Deliverable records assigned to a particular User (Stump).

Intended use

Called by the Responsibility and Deliverable Management UI or an AI agent to show a Stump's deliverable list. Parameter is stumpId (or ctx.user_id if Stump is calling).

Logic

  1. Determine targetStumpId: if ctx.role is 'stump', use ctx.user_id; otherwise, use params.stumpId and validate that params.stumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  2. Query Deliverable entities where idOfUser is targetStumpId using ctx.data.query.
  3. Return the list of Deliverable records.

Entities

  • Deliverable
  • User
